writtenTo: The twelve tribes scattered abroad (Jewish Christians)
importantNotes: 'Faith without works is dead' (2:17) — James and Paul complement each other, not contradict.
James is sometimes called 'the Proverbs of the New Testament.'
Martin Luther initially questioned James, but it teaches that real faith produces action.
James was the leader of the Jerusalem church and Jesus' half-brother.
'Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you' (4:8) — a beautiful promise.

chapters.1: Trials produce endurance; ask God for wisdom; be doers of the word, not hearers only.
chapters.2: Do not show favoritism; faith without works is dead — living faith produces action.
chapters.3: Taming the tongue — small but powerful; true wisdom is pure, peaceable, and gentle.
chapters.4: Submit to God; resist the devil; do not judge others; life is a mist.
chapters.5: Warning to the rich; patience in suffering; the prayer of faith; restoring the wandering.
